article.title: After the Final Amen: How the Black Repast Became a Ritual of Care, Memory, and Quiet Resistance
article.author: Venus Lockett
article.content: “See you at the repast,” I heard others say as they left the cemetery. And I immediately thought, “How am I supposed to eat anything after this?” Read more via Scalawag : After the Final Amen: How the Black Repast Became a Ritual of Care, Memory, and Quiet Resistance .
